_help: Orpheus's fighting kit, in pixels, seconds and hit points. An attack has three phases: startup (wind-up, can't hit yet), active (the club can hit) and recovery (can't act yet). 'on_beat' is what an input graded GOOD or PERFECT by the music clock earns: more damage, a perfect parry, and Muse. Nothing in combat requires the beat; it just rewards it. Change a number here and run the tests.

club_low._help: The crouch strike (hold Down, then Club): the same swing, low along the floor.
